items.title: The derived pullback of an m-pseudo-coherent object along a morphism of ringed sites is m-pseudo-coherent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that m-pseudo-coherence is preserved by derived pullback along a morphism of ringed sites (statement lines 12109-12116). Its content is a two-stage localisation followed by one computation with a distinguished triangle (proof lines 12118-12174): the locality lemmas reduce to the case of final objects, a strictly perfect witness F^bullet -> E is localised to a single one, and after applying Lf^* the cone C with H^j(C) = 0 for j >= m must have H^j(Lf^*C) = 0 in the same degrees, which is the vanishing property of a left derived functor; strict perfectness of f^*F^bullet supplies the witness. H2: two reductions and one triangle computation, all written out.
